noeuds.role: Leaves the current scene and goes to the chosen scene. This node ends the script.
noeuds.exemple: go to the “Well done!” screen after the last level.

noeuds.role: Goes to the scene whose name you type (or a formula giving that name). This node ends the script.
noeuds.exemple: a formula like ="Level" + level to choose the level with a variable.

noeuds.role: Goes to the scene placed just after in the scene list. This node ends the script.
noeuds.exemple: the player reaches the finish → next level.

noeuds.role: Goes to the scene placed just before in the scene list. This node ends the script.
Restarts the scene from the beginning: objects back in place and local variables back to their starting value. Global variables do not change.
Shows another scene on top of the game, like a layer (HUD), with its own Blueprint.
noeuds.exemple: a pause menu or an inventory.
the “Close” button of the pause menu.

noeuds.nom: Place a copy of a scene
noeuds.role: Places a copy of the chosen scene (prefab) in the game, at position X, Y.
noeuds.exemple: spawn a group of enemies prepared in another scene.

noeuds.nom: Destroy the copies of a scene
noeuds.role: Removes all copies of the chosen scene placed in the game.
noeuds.exemple: clear all enemy groups at the end of a wave.

noeuds.role: Closes the exported game. In the editor, nothing closes: use the stop button.
noeuds.exemple: a “Quit” button in the main menu.

noeuds.role: Shows a small message at the bottom of the screen for a few seconds. Start with = to show a calculation.
Writes a message in the project log (diagnostic file), without showing anything in the game. Start with = to write a calculation.
noeuds.exemple: ="health = " + vie, to check a value while testing.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, Follow X (true / false), Follow Y (true / false), Parallax X only (true / false)
noeuds.role: The camera follows the chosen object. You can make it follow only horizontally or vertically. With no object, the camera stops following.
noeuds.exemple: follow the player through a big platform level.

noeuds.role: Sets how fast the camera catches up with the followed object: 0.01 = very soft, 1 = stuck to the object.
noeuds.exemple: 0.1 for a smooth camera that follows with a slight delay.

noeuds.role: Shakes the screen with the chosen strength and duration (in milliseconds).
Makes the phone vibrate for the chosen duration (in milliseconds). Without a vibration motor, nothing happens.
noeuds.exemple: 100 ms when the player gets hit.

noeuds.role: Remembers the state of the scene (objects and variables) and the global variables, like a save point.
noeuds.exemple: a checkpoint flag in the middle of the level.

noeuds.role: Puts the scene back as it was at the last “Save state”. If there is no save yet, nothing changes.
noeuds.exemple: start again from the checkpoint after a fall.
